This indicates the Fed expects to lower, not raise rates in 2026. Additionally, inflation projections show PCE rising to 2.4% in 2026, still above the 2% target but not at levels that would typically trigger rate hikes. The Fed has been cutting rates through 2024-2025 as inflation cooled, and current projections suggest continued easing bias rather than tightening. While geopolitical risks and energy prices could change this outlook, the baseline Fed forecast strongly suggests cuts rather than hikes in 2026."}
